name: Checkpoint 09:35Z — did M1a (JWT key) and M1b (kwargs test) actually produce a reply?
description:
PM shift 40 (2026-11-18 03:35Z). Verify, do not assume.

WHY THIS CARD EXISTS
The two M1 cards were silent for 8 h after being re-issued at 19:37Z on 2026-11-17. The previous shift blamed `status=onhold`. That is DISPROVED: after the flip to `doing`, `message_count` stayed at 10 and `updated_at` stayed at 19:37:22 / 19:39:05 — no assistant message was ever stored.

ROOT CAUSE FOUND THIS SHIFT (two compounding PM errors, no code defect)
1. Both cards sat in the **`Blocked` column**. Cross-check of the board: the most recently processed card (`2adf8228`, updated 2026-11-17T20:33:31Z) has `wake_at: null` and an executable column; every card parked in `Blocked` (`c6c33374`, `4a1cf260`, `c8632422`, `e73c67e3`) is frozen.
2. Both carried `wake_at = 2026-11-18T19:37` — 16 h in the future. The worker only wakes tasks whose alarm is due, so nothing would have happened before tonight regardless.
The engine itself is alive: task `2adf8228` was updated at 20:33Z, an hour after the re-issue.

ACTION TAKEN (2026-11-18T03:35Z)
- `c6c33374` and `4a1cf260`: column `Blocked` → `To Do`, status kept `doing`, `wake_at` cleared, `due_date` 2026-11-19.

WHAT TO CHECK AT THIS CHECKPOINT (evidence only)
1. `get_task c6c33374` and `get_task 4a1cf260`: is `message_count` > 10 and is the last message role `assistant` with non-empty text?
   - An assistant message that is EMPTY is a failure, not progress (known defect family: `20dfb1f1` empty message on turn truncation).
2. If a reply exists: does it contain a test command + output line? Record it on the card, set progress, move to `Blocked` ONLY with a written reason.
3. If still silent: do NOT re-queue a third time. The next hypothesis is the per-chat stale turn lock documented in `42bdacee` (fix in tree, unverified because `820c9052` — api suite cannot collect — blocks its tests). In that case create a FRESH card with the same objective (a new chat id has no stale lock) and escalate `820c9052` as the real blocker.
4. Then re-forecast: M1 demo date is only promised once a card has replied with real output.

Acceptance: this card closes with either (a) a quoted test output line from M1a/M1b, or (b) a fresh replacement card id plus `820c9052` escalated.
